column4: api-config enforces no authorization
column5: lambda/api-config/index.ts:91-150 — Config handler does NO authz (no isAdmin/owner/group check). Any authenticated user can PUT /v1/devices/{sn}/config, /wifi, /fleets/{uid}/config. CDK route comments falsely claim enforcement (api-construct.ts:529,611). With self-signup->Viewer (auth-construct.ts:40), anyone can reconfigure/lock any device + push Wi-Fi creds. FIX: add JWT group/owner enforcement mirroring api-commands isAdmin/isDeviceOwner; fleet config->Admin, device config->Admin+owner.

column4: /v1/ingest has no authorizer or shared secret
column5: lib/api-construct.ts:736-741 + api-ingest/index.ts:135 — ingest route has no authorizer and no HMAC/shared-secret; trusts raw JSON body. Anyone with the URL can forge telemetry/GPS, fabricate alerts (real SNS email), force bogus Notecard swap. FIX: require Notehub shared-secret header (constant-time compare) or mTLS/WAF allowlist; reject unsigned before any write.
